text:
```yaml
name: NuGet Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - release
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
      - release

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [windows-latest, ubuntu-latest]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Setup .NET SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0'

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Build and test
        run: dotnet build --configuration Release /p:ContinuousIntegrationBuild=true && dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal

      - name: Determine version
        run: dotnet build ./build/Program.cs --target determine-version --configuration Release

      - name: Update version
        run: dotnet build ./build/Program.cs --target update-version --configuration Release

      - name: Push to NuGet (Windows only)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: dotnet build ./build/Program.cs --target push-to-nuget --configuration Release
        env:
          NUGET_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NUGET_API_KEY }}
```
